Ava: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few folks asked for concrete playbook steps for GPU shortages and region fallback. Putting notes here so we can iterate.
Sam: Thanks! can we outline who owns the decision to flip routing to burst capacity?
Priya: Ops owns the first-level decision (SRE), infra owns config changes for autoscaler. final approval for cross-region failover sits with oncall lead.
Diego: Is there an automated threshold we use or a manual trigger?
Priya: We have both. automated thresholds: 95% reserved GPU utilization for 5m + queue growth > 20%. manual trigger: paging if customer impact appears.
Marta: Customers on Dedicated want predictable behavior — can we guarantee no region swap without letting them opt-out?
Sam: Yes — Dedicated customers can opt-out via route_policy.allow_region_failover=false on their tenant. default is true for hosted.
Lynn: Putting the exact config here for reference:
Lynn: ```
route_policy: 
  allow_region_failover: true
  fallback_to_cpu: staged
  burst_capacity_policy: 
    enabled: true
    max_gpu_burst_percent: 30
```
Sam: For fallback to CPU-backed instances: it's a staged degradation. first we try lower-spec GPUs, then CPU-only endpoints for non-latency-critical workloads.
Ava: How do we communicate this to customers in the UI/announcements?
Marta: Plan: banner in console when failover is active + email to affected customers with timeline + support auto-created tickets.
Diego: What about model quality regressions when we fallback to quantized or CPU variants? can we pair with a canary A/B test?
Sam: Yes — rollout includes a 5% traffic canary to the degraded variant for 10m. infra-bot will monitor quality hooks and abort if delta > configured threshold.
infra-bot: Canary deployed gpu-fallback-canary -> cpu-variant (eu-west-1) at 2026-03-23T15:45:12Z. health OK.
Priya: Action items: 1) Sam to add playbook doc with decision tree, 2) Marta to draft customer comms, 3) Lynn to add automated pager thresholds to runbook.
Sam: I'll drop the initial playbook in #docs-infra by EOD tomorrow.
Marta: I'll share comms draft to legal + customer success by EOD Fri.
Lynn: I'll update the runbook and add the exact pager routing.
Ava: Thanks — one more ask: can we get a short dashboard widget for the console showing "fallback risk" (low/medium/high) based on supply signals?
Diego: I can prototype a small widget that pulls supply_signal + queue_length. ETA next week.
Priya: If anyone needs to test failover, ping me and I'll trigger a dry-run in staging.
Sam: thx all, this is helpful. closing the loop in the playbook once docs live. :thumbsup:
Marta: +1
Ava: Great work. we should rehearse this in the next ops drill.
Diego: noted — adding to the calendar.
__notes: Slack thread: concise Q&A and action items from all-hands about GPU supply, region failover, and autoscaler playbook
